entries.title: Ezekiel 45:1
segments: Shall offer an oblation; a portion of land which is to be set apart for the uses of the sanctuary and those who minister to it; as also for the city and prince.  See notes on

. 
 
vv 1-5. 
 
It is the ordinance of Christ, that they who devote themselves to the service of his people in word and doctrine, should receive from them a support.  The churches that neglect to provide for their pastors a suitable worldly maintenance, incur their Master's displeasure, and bring upon themselves spiritual leanness and weakness.

entries.title: Ezekiel 45:3
segments: Of this measure; that is, according to the measure just given. This verse is virtually a repetition of the preceding.

entries.title: Ezekiel 45:5
segments: And the five and twenty thousand; more literally, "a five and twenty thousand;" that is, another five and twenty thousand.

entries.title: Ezekiel 45:7
segments:
vv 7-16. 
 
The rulers of God's household must be patterns of justice and integrity in all their dealings; and that they may not be tempted to dishonest practices and oppression for filthy lucre's sake, the people are bound to make provision for their reasonable wants.

entries.title: Ezekiel 45:8
segments: And my princes shall no more oppress my people; having a sufficient portion assigned them for their maintenance.

entries.title: Ezekiel 45:13
segments: This is the oblation that ye shall offer; namely, to the prince,
; a very reasonable amount, considering the greatness of his prescribed charges for the public offerings.

entries.title: Ezekiel 45:17
segments: The whom God has elevated to stations of honor and influence, should be foremost in maintaining the ordinances of his sanctuary.
